prov.heading: Provision for Credit Losses
prov.text:
The Company recorded provision for credit losses expense of $4.9 million for the nine months ended September 30, 2026, compared to provision expense of $11.8 million during the comparable period of 2025 , a decrease of $6.9 million, or 58.4%. The decrease in provision expense between the respective periods was attributable to the allocation of reserves to a previously disclosed nonperforming credit during the first quarter of 2025. Net charge-offs were $5.1 million during the nine month period ended September 30, 2026, compared to $29.6 million during the comparable period of 2025 for a decrease of $24.5 million, or 82.9%. Net charge-offs for the first nine months of 2026 were primarily driven by a $2.0 million charge off to one commercial credit during the first quarter and a $2.8 million partial charge off of a separate, unrelated commercial credit during the third quarter of 2026. The decrease in charge offs between the respective periods was attributable to the partial charge off of the previously disclosed nonperforming credit during the second quarter of 2025.

The Company recorded provision expense of $1.2 million during the third quarter of 2026, compared to $2.0 million during the third quarter of 2025 .

net.heading: Net Income
net.text:
Net income was $83.8 million in the first nine months of 2026, which increased $10.3 million , or 14.0%, from $73.5 million for the comparable period of 2025 . Diluted earnings per common share were $3.31 in the first nine months of 2026 , an increase of 16.1% from $2.85 in the comparable period of 2025 . The increase in net income for the first nine months of 2026 was primarily due to an increase to net interest income of $12.0 million, or 7.3%, an increase to noninterest income of $2.4 million, or 6.8%, and a decrease in the provision for credit losses of $6.9 million, or 58.4%. Offsetting these positive contributions to the increase in net income was an increase in noninterest expense of $7.6 million, or 7.7%, and an increase to income tax expense of $3.4 million, or 21.5%.

Net income during the third quarter of 2026 was $28.9 million, an increase of 9.3% from $26.4 million for the comparable period of 2025. Diluted earnings per common share were $1.14 in the third quarter of 2026, an increase of 10.7% from $1.03 in the comparable period of 2025. The increase was driven primarily by an increase in net interest income of $4.6 million, or 8.3%, and a decrease in the provision for credit losses of $800,000, or 40.0%.

intro.text: Lakeland Financial Corporation ("Lakeland Financial"), an Indiana corporation incorporated in 1983, is a bank holding company headquartered in Warsaw, Indiana that provides, through its wholly owned subsidiary Lake City Bank (the "Bank") and together with Lakeland Financial (the "Company"), a broad array of financial products and services throughout its Northern and Central Indiana markets. The Company offers commercial and consumer banking services, as well as trust and wealth management, brokerage, and treasury management commercial services. The Company serves a diverse customer base, including commercial customers across a wide variety of industries including, among others, commercial real estate, manufacturing, agriculture, construction, retail, wholesale, finance and insurance, accommodation and food services, and health care.

lines.why: Cash can repay debt or be paid out: a financial asset. Cash needed to run the business is operating; move it if you know how much.

lines.name: Property, plant and equipment
lines.why: Assets used to produce and sell: operating.

lines.name: Operating lease right-of-use assets
lines.why: Leased stores, offices and equipment used in the business: operating.

lines.name: Equity-method investments
lines.why: Stakes in associated businesses, usually part of operations. Financial if held as an investment.

lines.name: Other assets, not tagged separately
lines.why: Total assets minus the lines above: assets the company tags its own way. Operating by default.

lines.name: Other liabilities, not tagged separately
lines.why: Total liabilities minus the lines above: liabilities the company tags its own way. Operating by default.
